title: Generation of affine base-change sections
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings with an $A$-algebra structure on $B$, and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Set $Y=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}B$ with projections $\pi,f_B$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For an affine open $U$ of $X$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis], let $P$ be any predicate on $\mathcal O_Y(\pi^{-1}U)$. Suppose $P$ holds on every $\pi^\sharp(d)$ for $d\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ and every restricted $f_B^\sharp(b)$ for $b\in B$, and is preserved by addition and multiplication. Then $P$ holds on every section in $\mathcal O_Y(\pi^{-1}U)$. No flatness, nonemptiness or module is assumed.

proof.text: Specialize Mathlib isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen to the cartesian square, the top opens of Spec A and Spec B, and U. isIso_pushoutSection_iff yields a pushout of section rings with the actual appLE maps.

The sections satisfying P form a subring: zero and one are images from O_X(U), and negatives are multiplication by the image of minus one. Both factor images lie in this subring. Scheme.ΓSpecIso for B converts the stated B-generator condition to the condition for all global sections on Spec B.

Apply Mathlib CommRingCat.closure_range_union_range_eq_top_of_isPushout to the affine section-ring pushout. Subring.closure_le places the closure of both factor images in the predicate subring. Since that closure is top, every section belongs to the predicate subring and satisfies P. This compiled argument also covers empty opens and zero rings.

theorem affineBaseChange_sections_induction
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    let Y := pullback f g
    let pi : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
    let fB : Y ⟶ Spec (.of B) := pullback.snd f g
    let C := (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} pi.base).obj Y.sheaf
    ∀ (P : C.obj.obj (op U.val) → Prop),
      (∀ d : X.presheaf.obj (op U.val), P (pi.app U.val d)) →
      (∀ b : B, P (Y.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top (a := pi ⁻¹ᵁ U.val))).op
        (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫ fB.appTop).hom b))) →
      (∀ r s, P r → P s → P (r + s)) →
      (∀ r s, P r → P s → P (r * s)) → ∀ r, P r
